chunks: 3389 - It is narrated from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥakīm, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام about a matter, and he said to me,
"For every unknown matter, there is qurʿah (casting lots) in it." So I said, "Indeed, qurʿah may miss and may be correct." Then he said,
"Everything by which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has judged is not mistaken."

key_terms.اللَّهُ: Allah, the Divine judge and legislator
key_terms.الْقُرْعَةُ: casting lots as a means of resolving uncertainty
key_terms.تُصِيبُ: to be correct or hit the right outcome

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام teach about using qurʿah in unknown matters?
ai.summary: This hadith states that in matters that remain unknown or indeterminate, qurʿah (casting lots) is a valid means of decision. The Imam عليه السلام clarifies that when such a process is sanctioned by Allah عزّ وجلّ, its judgment is not regarded as erroneous.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3389 - Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Hakim:

"I asked Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) about a matter.
Imam (as) said to me:

'For every unknown matter, the solution lies in casting lots (Qur'ah).'
I said: 'But casting lots can be right or wrong.'
Imam (as) replied:
'Whatever Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, decrees is never wrong.'"
